title: beast mode replaces kill streak rewards
why: His 10-28 order: get rid of double kill, triple kill and the rest; beast mode replaces them. Beast mode shipped in v36.27. Arcade scores will run lower: earlier leaderboard nights included streak multiplier and kill-count medal points. Watch: no more double or triple kill callouts; beast mode is the streak.
now: kills pay base sp without score chains, multiplier badges or kill-count medals; beast mode rewards quick kills.
